name: Cat Footwear

search.engine: SFCC search; category-matching queries 302-redirect to the category page (adds ?rst=<term>), other queries render a /US/en/search results page
search.capture: Read server-rendered .product-tile elements; product name/link in .product-tile a[href], dedupe by href base (each product has ~2 links). Grid container class pt_product-search-result. Category pages show an 'N Products' count; pure search pages do not. Top ~10 tiles render immediately; more lazy-load on scroll (scroll to load the full set, or use SFRA Search-UpdateGrid ajax with a larger size).
search.notes: No aggressive bot protection observed on paced navigations (unlike Target/PerimeterX). Server-rendered reads are gentle. Locale path /US/en/. Query 'work boots' redirects to /US/en/work-boots/ (category); 'trainers' stays on /search (true search).

notes: Cat Footwear (Caterpillar-licensed, Wolverine Worldwide) — work, outdoor, and lifestyle footwear. Salesforce Commerce Cloud / SFRA. Footwear sector. Search evaluated by reading the shopper-facing rendered results for a bounded query set — no crawling, no server load.
